data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Integrate Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard updates in real-time with current data
Includes line, bar, and area charts for various metrics
Data is accurate and reflects recent performance

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using an 8-stage pipeline chart
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts
Success rates are shown using area charts

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent Artemis runs to validate the system's effectiveness.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are sourced from recent data
Charts accurately reflect the data
Data is presented in a clear and compelling manner

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight Artemis features including cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning with metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Features are clearly described with supporting metrics
Charts accurately represent feature data
Content is engaging and informative

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file is standalone with no external dependencies
CSS and JavaScript are embedded within the HTML
Chart.js is included for data visualization

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with options for manual navigation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Users can manually navigate through slides
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Highlight Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Use a radar chart to demonstrate TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD and SOLID metrics
Data is sourced from recent code quality assessments
Chart is easy to interpret and visually appealing

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently
Transitions between slides are smooth
Overall look is professional and cohesive

features.title: Demonstrate Supervisor Integration
features.description: Show how supervisor integration works across different stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data
Stages are clearly labeled and differentiated
Integration benefits are highlighted
